transcript:
Balanced eating concerns a pattern across meals. Start with food you enjoy, can obtain and can prepare.

Foods provide overlapping combinations of energy and nutrients. A food-group diagram is a teaching tool, not a test of one meal.

Choose a practical change that fits your needs. Frozen or tinned options can contribute; a specialist product is not required by this example.

General guidance may need adapting for individual requirements. The Explorer percentage does not assess nutrient intake or replace appropriate dietary advice.
